subject: Question regarding Replacement Booking Credit validity in Bengaluru
message: I have a ₹2,000 replacement credit from a previous unfulfilled booking. Can I redeem it for a booking in Bengaluru next weekend?

replies.message: Hello Rahul, Yes! Your replacement booking credits are valid across all 22 Indian states and actively served cities on the platform.

subject: Updating supported cities to include Pune and Nashik
message: I would like to enable travel availability for Pune and Nashik weekend bookings in addition to Mumbai.

replies.message: Your profile has been updated and Pune/Nashik are now active in your supported cities.
